initial_candidates: up to 3 highest cells touching each historical polygon; equal chance
angle_prior: truncated normal mean25 sd5 bounds10..40 deg, uncalibrated
routing: random strictly downhill neighbour with probability proportional to slope^4
source_weights: equal source or affected-polygon area; neither calibrated occurrence weights
limitations: No volume, depth, entrainment, momentum runup or barrier model
Fixed 30m DEM: terrain uncertainty not sampled
Velocity is residual energy proxy, not measured or validated building impact speed
No new sources outside historical polygons
MC standard error is conditional simulation error, not epistemic confidence
Zero hits does not prove zero physical probability
No source activation rates or whole-building fragility attached
